title: PaymentSucceeded v1
description: Payment tells that the provider took the money for one payment attempt. Routing key: payment.payment-succeeded. Sent once per payment, even when the provider reports the success more than once (ADR-0006, rule R4). It can arrive after the booking has expired or was cancelled (a late success); Booking decides what to do then (rule R6). It carries identifiers and the amount only: no card data, no personal data. Consumers ignore unknown fields (ADR-0009, part F).

eventId.description: ID of this message, used by consumers to recognize duplicates

correlationId.description: Null today: the payment processor is not a request

aggregateId.description: The payment; the same as data.paymentId

bookingId.description: The booking the payment is for

attemptNumber.description: Which attempt for this booking; with bookingId it is the idempotency key of the attempt

amountMinor.description: The amount in the smallest unit of the currency
